programs.title: Fast X
programs.desc: Over many missions and against impossible odds, Dom Toretto and his family have outsmarted and outdriven every foe in their path. Now, they must confront the most lethal opponent they've ever faced. Fueled by revenge, a terrifying threat emerges from the shadows of the past to shatter Dom's world and destroy everything -- and everyone -- he loves.

programs.title: Ferrari
programs.desc: During the summer of 1957, bankruptcy looms over the company that Enzo Ferrari and his wife built 10 years earlier. He decides to roll the dice and wager it all on the iconic Mille Miglia, a treacherous 1,000-mile race across Italy.

programs.title: The Pitt
programs.desc: After a motorcycle collision, a husband and wife are rushed to the ER; as King and Javadi deal with a bickering family, Santos is forced to check her assumptions about a possible case of child abuse; Robby bonds with a Tree of Life survivor.

programs.title: The Amazing Maurice
programs.desc: Maurice is a streetwise ginger cat who comes up with a money-making scam by befriending a group of talking rats. However, when Maurice and the rodents reach the town of Bad Blintz, their little con soon goes down the drain.

programs.title: Amish Affair
programs.desc: Hannah knows her secret relationship with Aaron, a charismatic Amish leader, has them both living in sin, so she decides to end it. However, when Aaron's wife suspiciously dies, she finds herself framed for murder and fighting to prove her innocence.

programs.title: Night of the Zoopocalypse
programs.desc: When a meteor unleashes a virus that turns zoo animals into zombies, a mountain lion and a wolf lead a team of survivors to save the day.

programs.title: Garage Sale Mystery: The Novel Murders
programs.desc: Antiques expert Jennifer Shannon believes two items found at the scene of a murder are actually clues straight out of famous mystery stories.

programs.title: The Wish Swap
programs.desc: When Casey and Henry find themselves celebrating their birthdays at the same restaurant, they make birthday wishes at the same time which are granted. However, they end up getting each other's wishes.

programs.title: Air Bud: Seventh Inning Fetch
programs.desc: The golden retriever joins a middle-school baseball team and searches for his missing offspring.

programs.title: Air Bud: Spikes Back
programs.desc: A dog that plays volleyball helps investigators solve a rash of mysterious crimes.

programs.title: Shayda
programs.desc: Shayda, a brave Iranian mother, finds refuge in an Australian women's shelter with her six-year-old daughter, where they take solace in new beginnings. When the estranged husband and father re-enters their lives, Shayda's path to freedom is jeopardized.

programs.title: Never Say Never Again
programs.desc: An aging James Bond (Sean Connery) makes an uncharacteristic mistake during a routine training mission, leading M (Edward Fox) to believe that the legendary British Intelligence spy is now past his prime. M indefinitely suspends Bond from active duty. However, when SPECTRE member Fatima Bush (Barbara Carrera) and her fellow terrorists successfully steal two nuclear missiles from the U.S. military, M must reinstate Bond, as he is the only agent who can beat SPECTRE at their own game of espionage.
